question: Why does a tennis tie-break change server after the first point and then after every two?
answer: To share the server's edge evenly. Top players win most points on serve, so the order runs A, BB, AA, BB: after every even number of points both have served the same number, and at any moment the gap is at most one. Neither player can take the tie-break by holding serve alone.
move: To judge whether a sequence is fair, check who leads at every step.
reference: International Tennis Federation, Rules of Tennis 2024, Rule 5 Score in a game, tie-break game
